definitionZh: 滚动-snap-ign属性指定了盒的坐标位置,作为其坐标容器的坐标端口(作为坐标容器)内的坐标区域(作为坐标标的)的坐标位置。
sourceDefinition: The scroll-snap-align property specifies the box's snap position as an alignment of its snap area (as the alignment subject) within its snap container's snap port (as the alignment container).

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The scroll-snap-align property specifies the box's snap position as an alignment of its snap area (as the alignment subject) within its snap container's snap port (as the alignment container).
